scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Ocean Dreamer Moa. Today, we're going on an amazing journey about confidence. Are you ready to explore the wonders of being brave and strong? I'm so curious about what makes you feel confident. Let's dive into our adventure together!

Confidence is like a special power inside you, helping you try new things. Imagine you're about to climb a big hill, and you feel a little scared. But then, you remember how brave you are inside. That feeling of knowing you can do it is called confidence. Like when you learn to ride a bicycle, at first it seems tricky, but with confidence, you can pedal faster and faster. Now, let's think about a time when you felt brave. Wasn't it exciting?

Now, let's learn how to grow our confidence. One way is by practicing something every day. Just like brushing your teeth every morning, practicing a new skill makes you better at it. If you want to learn how to draw, try drawing a little each day. Each time you practice, your confidence grows, like a tiny seed turning into a tall tree. Remember, it's okay if it's not perfect at first. Every try makes you stronger.

Wonderful! You're doing great just by listening and learning. Let's take a deep breath together and feel our confidence grow. Breathe in... and out. Great job! Breathing helps us feel calm and strong inside. Whenever you feel unsure, take a deep breath and say, 'I can do it!' This magic phrase can help you feel ready to face anything.

Remember when we talked about practicing? Let's imagine you're a little bird learning to fly. At first, flapping your wings might feel wobbly. But with each try, you soar a bit higher. Just like the bird, your confidence grows with every attempt. It's okay to make mistakes because they teach us how to do better next time. So, let's be like that bird and keep trying!

Let's play a little game to boost our confidence. Think of something you really want to try, like building a tall block tower. Now, imagine yourself doing it step by step. First, you carefully place one block, then another, and soon you have a tower! Visualizing your success helps your mind believe you can do it. It's like dreaming with your eyes open!

You're amazing! Every small step you take is a big leap toward being more confident. Let's celebrate by clapping our hands three times. Ready? One, two, three! Great! Each clap is a cheer for your effort and courage. Whenever you feel proud, give yourself a little cheer. You deserve it!

Now, let's think about how we can help others feel confident too. When you encourage a friend, it's like sharing a piece of your confidence with them. If a friend feels shy about speaking in class, you can say, 'I believe in you!' Your kind words can make a big difference. Helping others feel brave makes you even stronger inside.

Can you think of a time when you helped someone feel confident? Maybe you cheered for a friend during a game or helped them learn something new. How did it make you feel? Did you notice a big smile on their face? Sharing confidence is a wonderful gift. Let's always be there to support each other!

Great! Now let's imagine we are explorers on a treasure hunt. The treasure we are seeking is confidence! Every time we try something new, we find a piece of that treasure. Like trying a new food or meeting a new friend. Each new experience adds to our treasure chest of confidence. How exciting is that?

Confidence is like a little light inside you that shines bright. Even when things are hard, that light helps you see the way. Like when you're playing a new game, and it's a bit tricky, your confidence light guides you to keep trying. It's important to remember that everyone has this light, and it can grow brighter each day. Let's keep our lights shining strong!

Let's practice something fun to make our confidence shine. Stand up tall and stretch your arms wide like a big, strong tree. Feel how strong you are! Now, say with me, 'I am brave, I am strong, I can do anything!' Great! This power pose helps remind us of our inner strength. You can do this whenever you need a confidence boost!

You're doing an amazing job! Each time you practice confidence, you become more and more powerful. Let's give ourselves a big hug to celebrate our bravery. Wrap your arms around yourself and squeeze tight. This hug is a reminder of how wonderful you are. Keep believing in yourself, and you can achieve anything!

Wow, what a fantastic journey we've had today! Thank you for exploring the world of confidence with me. Remember, you are brave, strong, and full of wonderful possibilities. Keep practicing, keep shining, and never forget how amazing you are. Until next time, my little explorer, keep dreaming big. Goodbye for now!
